title: A note on shifting distributions via Poisson races
summary: This expository note is about simulating a target distribution $Q$ from observations of a proposal distribution $P$. In the model suggested by Harsha, Jain, McAllester and Radhakrishnan, we observe an infinite sequence of i.i.d. samples $X_1,X_2,\ldots$ from $P$. The goal is to find some index $I \in \{1,2,\ldots\}$ such that $X_I$ is distributed like $Q$ while minimizing $\mathbb{E} \log I$.
